Variant runner: experiment.py loads YAML configs, resolves solver by name, instantiates per-variant model/solver/budget/TTL, prints comparison table

Deterministic scoring: code_quality uses structural signals (has_code, has_types, has_test, is_minimal, no_any), efficiency uses char/tool/runtime counts. LLM judge is optional secondary via code_quality_llm()

Live pipeline runner: claude_code_with_skills solver loads CLAUDE.md + flow SKILL.md + domain skills as system prompt. bare_prompt solver provides control group. experiment.py comparison mode shows per-variant results
